Fellowship update

The spring cohort finished in May. The full result is in the spring report, and the method is described in our guide to measuring what happens to fellows after the program, which we revise each year.

What changed

Admissions. We moved the deadline and rewrote the form. See the result for yourself.

• Mentors now meet fellows every week instead of every month, which fellows asked for in the last survey.

• The capstone is required.
